notes.title: Twist of Destiny is retiring
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,
[/p][p]We're writing to you today with some news about [i]Twist of Destiny[/i].
[/p][p]This game was one of our first projects on Steam, which we started about eight years ago. We poured a lot of heart into it back when we were just getting our feet wet in game development. While we worked on it everyday for more than a year, it only saw very little income, and we eventually had to make the tough call to shift our focus to other projects and genres where we felt we had a better chance of succeeding.[/p][p]It's been a long time since we've been able to work on the game, and we don't feel right having it remain on the store in an unfinished state. With that in mind, we've decided to officially retire it from sale on Steam.[/p][p][b]What this means:[/b][/p][list][*][p]If you already own the game, you'll still be able to download and play it as normal.[/p][/*][*][p]It will no longer be available for purchase on Steam after a certain date.[/p][/*][/list][p]We'll be sure to let you know the exact retirement date once we confirm it with Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your understanding.[/p][p]All the best,
-OneShark.[/p]

notes.title: Twist of Destiny First Update in 1 Year! We're Back!
notes.notes:
[h1]Behold. The Turn based RPG is still alive and thriving[/h1]

We have performed some preliminary updates here including:

- New NPC in Ranalong: Magillicutty guards the palace
- New Quest for Magillicutty

- New NPC GingerJake in opening town, quests to come

- New MonsterPedia feature! Track your kills, explore your enemies!

- Achievements added - Yeyeyeyeyea yeah.

- Nerfed the length of the Underground Swamp Mines and they are incorporated in the new quest for Magillicutty.


COMING SOON: many many many quests to make the beginning content more fun!  ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update News 4.17.17
notes.notes:
We have added a new quest type called Job Quests, which are repeatable, have a custom graphic and will help round out the questing. Check on Ray King in Ranalong for an example

*We have fixed the bug menu to only include email address and removed the "Mail To" link which was bugged.

*We debugged some of the mines issues.

*We fixed Blind Judges dash+burning skill 

UP NEXT:
Trading Cards, Demo, AchievementS

Thanks for playing!
